{
  "phoneNote": "The warm identity works, but the first-screen photo shows mostly foliage while the large text card hides the restaurant.",
  "desktopNote": "The restaurant imagery and palette feel specific, but oversized headings and broad empty areas make the page unnecessarily long.",

    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,

  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Merge the reservation contact section and footer contact blocks into one area containing the phone number, address, directions, hours and email; retain only legal information beneath it.",
    "Reduce desktop hero and group-reservation heading sizes, use fewer lines, and place the group enquiry action beside its supporting text rather than across a large empty field.",
    "Use a phone-specific hero crop that reveals the building or terrace, and shorten the text card’s vertical padding so the photograph communicates the setting."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone: the footer repeats the address, directions and opening hours immediately after the reservation contact section.",
    "Desktop: the footer repeats the address, directions and opening hours already presented in the reservation contact section."
  ]
}
